post.description: Creates and assigns a seat to an existing DSP account. </br>**Note:** This route uses the old IX App architecture and will soon be deprecated. get.description: Returns the data associated to the accounts that you are authorized to access along with the total number of accounts. If you are a part of an account group, you will receive data for all the accounts that are a part of the account group.
